5-STAR Restaurant.name: 5-Star
5-STAR Restaurant.summary: Yongbok works delivering food for the 5-STAR Restaurant (which his boss says it’s a 5-star Michelin even though there’s no such thing). He must travel to various locations and deliver food boxes to various houses. But he must be careful, for there are mischievous creatures who want to take food boxes from his hands.

Flintstones, The - The Surprise at Dinos.name: The Flintstones: The Surprise at Dinosaur Peak!
Flintstones, The - The Surprise at Dinos.summary: Pebbles and Bamm-Bamm have wandered away from home and it looks like Fred and Barney found them. Unfortunately, an active volcano stands in the way. Now, Fred and Barney must travel across the pre-hysterical world of Bedrock to rescue the kids! Fred swings a mean club and Barney's sling carries a nasty sting in this adventure for the whole family. Scale the side of a cliff, use crocodiles as trampolines, and leap into action as Bedrock's most famous citizens go looking for their children. Collect the hidden five fabled fire gemstones to pay a greedy Pterodactyl to return Pebbles and Bamm-Bamm to their homes!

Karate Kid, The.name: The Karate Kid
Karate Kid, The.summary: The Karate Kid was a game published by LJN for the NES. It is loosely based on The Karate Kid, Part II.

Nuts & Milk.name: Nuts & Milk
Nuts & Milk.summary: Nuts & Milk is a platform-style puzzle game developed and published by Japanese software developer Hudson Soft in 1983. The game was released initially on the FM-7, MSX, NEC PC-8801, NEC PC-6001, and later to the Famicom in Japan. It was the first third party video game to be released on a Nintendo console.

Puss 'n Boots - Pero's Great Adventure.name: Puss 'n Boots: Pero's Great Adventure
Puss 'n Boots - Pero's Great Adventure.summary: Pero is Puss 'n Boots of storybook fame and he's caught up in a whirlwind adventure, traveling through time and around the world! True-blue Pero has been "cat-apulted" back through time by the terrible Count Gruemon. Now Pero must cross many dangerous lands to defeat Count Gruemon and recover the Time Machine which will return Pero home. It's a "cat-astrophe!"

Super Robin Hood.name: Super Robin Hood
Super Robin Hood.summary: Super Robin Hood is a side scrolling puzzle platformer developed by Codemasters, published by Camerica and was on the Quattro Adventure multicart released for the NES in 1993.
